rules.statement: To impeach a will on the ground of undue influence, it must be proved that the influence exercised amounted to coercion, i.e., compelled the testator to do something he did not want to do.
rules.supporting_quote: "To impeach a will on the ground of undue influence, it must be proved . that the influence exercised amounted to coercion, i.e., compelled the testator to do something he did not want to do."
